definitions.monthly_inflow_vnd: Average monthly cash inflow in VND
definitions.unified_credit_score: Standardised credit rating, excluded from primary model
definitions.dti_ratio: Monthly estimated debt obligations divided by inflow
definitions.on_time_bill_ratio: Ratio of bills paid on time
definitions.interest_rate_pct: Assigned nominal annual rate; excluded predictor
definitions.is_default_90d: 90 or more days past due during loan tenure; target only

limitations: Synthetic competition data; not validated for real lending.
is_default_90d means 90+ days past due during loan tenure, not default within 90 days.
All positive labels occur among applications declined by both supplied decision methods; outcome provenance requires confirmation.
Outcome maturity dates and repeated-person identifiers are unavailable.
Primary model excludes opaque unified_credit_score, assigned interest rate, IDs, segment and all historical decisions/outcomes.
Model output is a simulated risk estimate. Demo thresholds and pricing are illustrative.
